name: Automox — Managed Devices
description: Pull managed device inventory and patch status from Automox

steps.instruction: Log into the Automox console at console.automox.com
Generate a new API key. Copy the key value.

validation_request.error_message: Could not authenticate with Automox. Check your API key.

transform.expr: {'ip': record.get('ip_addrs', [''])[0] if record.get('ip_addrs') else '', 'hostname': record.get('name', ''), 'fqdn': record.get('name', ''), 'device_id': str(record.get('id', '')), 'display_name': record.get('name') or (record.get('ip_addrs', [''])[0] if record.get('ip_addrs') else '')}

{'agent_version': record.get('agent_version', ''), 'needs_reboot': record.get('needs_reboot', False), 'patch_count': record.get('patches_pending', 0), 'is_compatible': record.get('is_compatible', ''), 'serial_number': record.get('serial_number', ''), 'group_name': record.get('server_group_id', ''), 'tags': record.get('tags', [])}
